crossrefs.text: “Be strong and courageous! Do not be afraid or discouraged before the king of Assyria and the vast army with him, for there is a greater One with us than with him.
With him is only the arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles.” So the people were strengthened by the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
The weapons of our warfare are not the weapons of the flesh. Instead, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.
We demolish arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
My message and my preaching were not with persuasive words of wisdom, but with a demonstration of the Spiritʼs power,
so that your faith would not rest on menʼs wisdom, but on Godʼs power.
No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
The Spirit of the LORD will rest on Him— the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and strength, the Spirit of knowledge and fear of the LORD.

notes.title: Zerubbabel's hands will finish the temple

crossrefs.text: Though your beginnings were modest, your latter days will flourish.
He chose the lowly and despised things of the world, and the things that are not, to nullify the things that are,
so that no one may boast in His presence.

For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth, to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose hearts are fully devoted to Him. You have acted foolishly in this matter. From now on, therefore, you will be at war.”
‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not appear to you like nothing in comparison?’
He put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a man took and planted in his field.
He told them still another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”
These witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
